line.message: Each line in tickets.md must read "<key>, <story file>, created <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM>", like "SUBS-156, 2026-10-02-skip-next-box.md, created 2026-10-02 14:05".

badTimeMessage: The created time must be a real date and time, like "created 2026-10-02 14:05".
noStoryMessage: There is no story {file} in stories/.
notWrittenMessage: {file} isn't a finished story: its first line isn't "Call: Story written", so it can't have a ticket.
duplicateStoryMessage: {file} already has a ticket, {key}. A story gets one ticket.
